summary: Request for limited, field-level redaction of production session traces for legal e-discovery
description: Issue summary: Legal has requested a narrow export of session traces tied to an e-discovery subpoena for CustomerX. They only need a sample of session-level metadata and user-visible output for a 30-day window. Impact: Legal needs the export for a compliance deadline (2026-03-18). We must avoid exposing raw prompt tokens, API keys, or backend-only PII. Request: Approve a limited, field-level redaction process that extracts derivative session traces (session id, timestamp, model version, routing decision, anonymized user identifier, sanitized output) for the window 2026-02-01 -> 2026-03-02. Redaction rules: remove request.prompt_raw, replace user_id with HMAC-256 pseudonymization (per runbook), mask any detected IPs and emails, strip any KVs labeled as 'sensitive' in the trace schema. Deliverable: gzipped NDJSON with per-line JSON objects (sanitized) and an audit manifest recording redaction operations. Access: temporary S3 presigned URL to Legal with read-only permissions; copy to legal bucket is OK after audit logs recorded. Constraints: No full privileged console session access. Justification: subpoena; Legal (contact: Maya Kapoor) has provided the paperwork. Time sensitivity: expiring legal deadline in 8 days. Data minimization: prefer sampling (1k sessions) and prioritized by sessions flagged for "CustomerX" only. Approver(s) requested: Security lead (SRE Security), Compliance Officer, and Head of Legal.
comments: 2026-03-10 Alex Chen: Filed request after Legal emailed final subpoena PDF. Attached subpoena to internal email thread. Requested minimal export and pseudonymization approach per runbook.
2026-03-10 Priya Patel: Acknowledged. Will inventory which buckets/traces are needed and validate telemetry schema for 'sensitive' KV flags. Tentative ETA for inventory: 2026-03-11 EOD.
2026-03-11 Maya Kapoor (Legal): Confirming scope limited to CustomerX sessions and consent to pseudonymization. Need delivery by 2026-03-18.

2026-03-11 Jordan Liu (SRE Security): Will require Security review + audit of access. Proposed approach: create ephemeral export job that writes to an encrypted staging bucket with server-side KMS, retention 30 days, and automatic deletion.
investigation_notes: Checked serving-runtime retention and trace indexing: traces for the requested window are archived in prod S3 prefix s3://redwood-prod-traces/2026/02/.

Ran schema scan on trace objects (sample): fields present include request.prompt_raw, request.prompt_summary, response.text, kvcache.* and metadata.user_id. There are existing 'sensitive' KV flags in ~2% of traces for PII markers.
Validated that HMAC-256 pseudonymization utilities exist in internal/tools/pseudonymize and are approved by Security for legal exports (see GH PR linked).
Audited prior privileged extractions: previous approval flow required Security + Compliance sign-off and an audit manifest. Followed similar checklist from INT-12456 example.
Confirmed that streaming responses may include partial tokens; will redact request.prompt_raw and include only prompt_summary field with length threshold applied.
Cost estimate: extraction job for 1k sampled sessions ~0.5 GPU-hours for transformation; S3 egress negligible to internal legal bucket.
resolution_notes: 2026-03-11 Security approved conditional access: ephemeral job to run in VPC with KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111222:alias/legal-export-key and write to s3://redwood-legal-staging/INT-15243/.

Applied redaction rules: removed request.prompt_raw, replaced user_id using HMAC-256 with salt stored in Secrets Manager (access logged), masked IP and email regex matches, stripped KVs flagged 'sensitive'. Added a 'redaction_version' field = 'rv1.2' to each output object.

Sampling decision: 1,200 sessions prioritized by CustomerX session flag and highest-likelihood relevance (per Legal). Full sample list exported in manifest (manifest includes original object keys hashed for traceability).

Access granted: Legal team (maya.kapoor@redwood.ai) given presigned URL valid for 72 hours. SRE retained IAM role 'legal-exporter' for job execution. All access and object copies logged and exported to compliance log index 'legal-exports'.

Follow-ups: Remove staging bucket contents on 2026-04-10, rotate export KMS key access, and file a short post-action note to Confluence. Also schedule a debrief with Legal and Security to review whether pseudonymization satisfies subpoena terms.
Ticket status updated to 'Resolved' after handoff to Legal and confirmation of download on 2026-03-11 16:22 UTC.
